about.title: About LearningPanama
paragraphs: LearningPanama is a free space to learn English, created for Spanish speakers who want clear explanations and real practice.
Every lesson combines a short video with a written guide so you can learn at your own pace: watch, read, pause and repeat.
The site is available in English and Spanish, so you can understand the explanations while you train your English.
values: Pronunciation lessons focused on sounds that are hard for Spanish speakers
Writing guides, from simple sentences to full paragraphs
Useful resources that go beyond the lessons
